# Smarter steels for people and planet

ArcelorMittal is redefining steel for the modern world
* [
  Learn about us
  ][138]

[AM_Hero.jpg]

## Global operations bring a world of opportunity

ArcelorMittal’s unique global reach brings many advantages: consistency for our customers, mobility
for our people, diversification for our investors and resilience for our business. And as we
continue to grow responsibly, so do the opportunities we create.
* [See how we lead][139]

## Reflections from our CEO on 20 years of ArcelorMittal

As ArcelorMittal approaches its 20-year anniversary, our CEO, Aditya Mittal, looks back on two
decades of progress and discusses the priorities that will shape our future. 
* [Read more][140]

[Steel Talks Corp.png]

In the second episode of a three-part series exploring ArcelorMittal’s role in the energy
transition, host Tom Cheesewright is joined by ArcelorMittal Automotive and Electrical Steels
leaders from North America, Europe, China and Global R&D.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

prompt shipping and competitive pricing on all orders.

avionics][172], [tools][173], [charts][174], [propellers][175], [spruce][176], [software][177],

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

engaged in design, engineering, construction, testing, commissioning and servicing of a wide range
of products and services with over 180 product offerings to meet the ever-growing needs of the core
sectors of economy.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with

**About Conan Exiles**

[Conan Exiles][57] is an open-world survival game, in the brutal lands of Conan The Barbarian. You
are an exile, one of thousands cast out to fend for themselves in a barbaric wasteland swept by
terrible sandstorms and besieged on every side by [Enemies][58]. Here you must fight to survive,
build and dominate.

Hungry, thirsty and alone, your very first battle is that against the harsh environment. [Grow][59]
crops or [Hunt][60] animals for food. [Harvest][61] [Resources][62] to [Craft][63] [Weapons][64] and
[Tools][65]. [Build][66] a shelter to survive. Ride across a vast world and explore alone, or band
together with other players to build entire [Settlements][67] and [Strongholds][68] to withstand
fierce invasions.

When strong enough, march forth into battle and wage war against your enemies as you fight to
dominate the exiled lands. Sacrifice enemy [Players][69] on the [Altars][70] of the [Gods][71] and
shift the balance of power your way. Unleash your fury in savage, fast-paced [Combat][72] and
execute bloody and bone-crushing attacks that will see heads rolling and limbs flying.

Conan Exiles is ["Available on Steam"][73] with new updates as a brutal open-world survival game!

Welcome to the Official Conan Exiles Wiki
The [Conan Exiles][47] reference manual written and maintained by the players.
We currently have [16 active editors][48] maintaining [28,184 pages (12,417 articles)][49].
Conan Exiles Wiki in: [Deutsch][50], **English**, [Français][51], [Italiano][52], [Polski][53],

**About Conan Exiles**

[Conan Exiles][57] is an open-world survival game, in the brutal lands of Conan The Barbarian. You
are an exile, one of thousands cast out to fend for themselves in a barbaric wasteland swept by
terrible sandstorms and besieged on every side by [Enemies][58]. Here you must fight to survive,
build and dominate.

Hungry, thirsty and alone, your very first battle is that against the harsh environment. [Grow][59]
crops or [Hunt][60] animals for food. [Harvest][61] [Resources][62] to [Craft][63] [Weapons][64] and
[Tools][65]. [Build][66] a shelter to survive. Ride across a vast world and explore alone, or band
together with other players to build entire [Settlements][67] and [Strongholds][68] to withstand
fierce invasions.

When strong enough, march forth into battle and wage war against your enemies as you fight to
dominate the exiled lands. Sacrifice enemy [Players][69] on the [Altars][70] of the [Gods][71] and
shift the balance of power your way. Unleash your fury in savage, fast-paced [Combat][72] and
execute bloody and bone-crushing attacks that will see heads rolling and limbs flying.

Conan Exiles is ["Available on Steam"][73] with new updates as a brutal open-world survival game!

Euroresins is one of Europe´s leading distributors of premium products for the composite industry.
We supply a wide range of materials including:
* Resins,
* Fire retardant systems,
* Mould building and mould care solutions,
* Gelcoats and topcoats,
* Pigment pastes,
* Initiators & Accelerators,
* Bonding pastes and adhesives,
* Glass fibre-reinforced plastics (GRP),
* Core materials,
* Machinery, safety and laminating tools and others.

Euroresins market special products of some of the best resin manufacturers in the world like SIR,
Poliya, United Initiators, SCI Group and many more. Furthermore, we also have a wide network of
manufacturers which follows technical guidelines and produces A-grade quality of resins like Ortho,
ISO, VE, and indicative tested resins & gelcoat for fire protection under our own brand name **ESI**
and **Fire Repel** respectively.

Euroresins is at the forefront of innovation and service and is present across Europe including the
**United Kingdom, Germany, France, Benelux, Spain, Italy, Norway, Sweden, and Finland.** We are
partnered with few of industry’s well-known players as well as have our own manufacturing plant
where we produce core materials, cables and condenstop under our sister company Lantor, BV.

**About Lantor: –**

With our own manufacturing set up, in-house laboratory and testing capabilities in the Netherlands,
we can provide world’s best composite solutions to our customers in the form of textile foam cores
and surface veils. Our products like **COREMAT, SORIC, TECCORE (Patented), SKINCORE, and FINISHMAT**
are highly specialized A-brand products, offering solutions in open moulding, infusion, autoclave,
and continuous processing techniques.

Our solutions provide light weight and material saving, surface quality enhancement and protection,
easy processing and with unique functionalities of screw retention, impact resistance, and
compression resistance. Lantor products are providing solutions to industries like Automotive and
Transportation, Marine, Sports & Leisure, and Construction across **Europe, North America (USA,
Canada) APAC, (Australia, New Zealand, India, China) and Middle East & Africa (Dubai, Egypt,
Tunisia, Morocco)**.

To know more about our products & technical services, **please visit our website:**
[https://lantor.com/][22]

**Euroresins is a part of the Cathay Investments Group. Our other group companies provide following
services:**

Third Party Pallet Network (HazChem network)

Chemical storage

Pallet and Courier services

Chemical ocean freight forwarding

Container transport

Continental haulage

**Please visit** [www.cathay-investments.com][23] **for more information.**

[/fullwidth]

## About us

Hand and Sew Leather was established by Steven Enns in 2011. Although it began as a small wallet
making business, Steven quickly learned his passion lay in sourcing high quality materials and
providing education and support in all things leather.

The retail store was opened in 2020, and his wife Leah joined the growing team.

Together they have been offering their knowledge and expertise in the world of leather, tools,
supplies, crafting, design, and business ever since.

# Revolutionizing Construction With Advanced Steel Reinforcement

As a leader among steel reinforcement manufacturers, Helix Steel provides superior products backed
by exceptional support from design to installation.

[Learn More][59]

Helix® Micro Rebar® exemplifies our commitment to proven engineering, reduced labor costs, and
shorter project times. This twisted steel micro-reinforcement enhances concrete strength and
durability, making construction better, faster, and more efficient.
Our steel reinforcement company is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. We proudly distribute
Helix® Micro Rebar® and our other products globally, providing construction operations around the
world with a better way to build with concrete.

Contact Us
Submit a Project

### A Legacy of Innovation and Engineering

The roots of our reinforcement company date back to the late 1990s at the University of Michigan,
where Helix’s founder, Luke Pinkerton, aimed to solve concrete’s inherent weakness. His exhaustive
research led to the development of a small, twisted metal fiber and resulted in the official launch
of Helix Steel and Helix® Micro Rebar® in 2003.


This innovative product stemmed from Luke’s findings that it made concrete structures more resilient
and ductile than traditional manufacturing methods.


Helix has experienced tremendous growth over the years — Helix® Micro Rebar® has been a key
component in over 40,000 construction projects. A key milestone was attaining ISO 9001-2015
accreditation for quality manufacturing.


FORTA, LLC.’s acquisition of Helix in 2024 has positioned the company for accelerated growth and a
stronger presence in a highly competitive marketplace.


[Contact us to learn more][60] about our reinforcement company.

## Our Superior Steel Reinforcement Offerings

Helix products go far beyond traditional rebar. Our Helix® Micro Rebar® sets us apart from other
rebar manufacturers. This revolutionary Twisted Steel Micro Rebar® (TSMR®) is mixed directly into
the concrete, creating enhanced three-dimensional reinforcement. Experience increased concrete
tensile strength, shear strength, durability, and crack resistance.

Our flagship Helix® 5-25 Micro Rebar™ offers numerous benefits:

#### Saves You Time

Every 10,000 sq. ft. of rebar replaced with Micro Rebar® saves one full day of construction.

#### Saves You Money

Using Micro Rebar® allows contractors to simplify operations, dramatically reducing project costs.

#### A Superior Product

When compared to rebar, Helix® Micro Rebar® can increase fatigue resistance by up to 300%, and
flexural strength by up to 33%.

[Explore Benefits][61]
* ##### People-first approach:
  
  Our firm commitment to customer support includes guidance from the initial design phase through
  on-site installation.
* ##### Commitment to sustainability:
  
  Our advanced technologies reduce the amount of cement needed, resulting in a smaller carbon
  footprint. We have implemented renewable energy to achieve our goal of carbon neutrality by 2050.
* ##### Proven expertise and reliability:
  
  We have a long list of successful projects, such as the MTA subway tunnel in Manhattan and the
  platform for Seattle’s Ferris Wheel.

#### Why Choose Helix?

As your partner in advanced construction, Helix has more to offer than the other steel rebar
manufacturers:

#### [Concrete Slabs][62]

[Learn More][63]

#### [Footings & Foundations][64]

[Learn More][65]

#### [Concrete Walls][66]

# Revolutionizing Construction With Advanced Steel Reinforcement

As a leader among steel reinforcement manufacturers, Helix Steel provides superior products backed
by exceptional support from design to installation.

[Learn More][59]

Helix® Micro Rebar® exemplifies our commitment to proven engineering, reduced labor costs, and
shorter project times. This twisted steel micro-reinforcement enhances concrete strength and
durability, making construction better, faster, and more efficient.
Our steel reinforcement company is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. We proudly distribute
Helix® Micro Rebar® and our other products globally, providing construction operations around the
world with a better way to build with concrete.

Contact Us
Submit a Project

### A Legacy of Innovation and Engineering

The roots of our reinforcement company date back to the late 1990s at the University of Michigan,
where Helix’s founder, Luke Pinkerton, aimed to solve concrete’s inherent weakness. His exhaustive
research led to the development of a small, twisted metal fiber and resulted in the official launch
of Helix Steel and Helix® Micro Rebar® in 2003.


This innovative product stemmed from Luke’s findings that it made concrete structures more resilient
and ductile than traditional manufacturing methods.


Helix has experienced tremendous growth over the years — Helix® Micro Rebar® has been a key
component in over 40,000 construction projects. A key milestone was attaining ISO 9001-2015
accreditation for quality manufacturing.


FORTA, LLC.’s acquisition of Helix in 2024 has positioned the company for accelerated growth and a
stronger presence in a highly competitive marketplace.


[Contact us to learn more][60] about our reinforcement company.

## Our Superior Steel Reinforcement Offerings

Helix products go far beyond traditional rebar. Our Helix® Micro Rebar® sets us apart from other
rebar manufacturers. This revolutionary Twisted Steel Micro Rebar® (TSMR®) is mixed directly into
the concrete, creating enhanced three-dimensional reinforcement. Experience increased concrete
tensile strength, shear strength, durability, and crack resistance.

Our flagship Helix® 5-25 Micro Rebar™ offers numerous benefits:

#### Saves You Time

Every 10,000 sq. ft. of rebar replaced with Micro Rebar® saves one full day of construction.

#### Saves You Money

Using Micro Rebar® allows contractors to simplify operations, dramatically reducing project costs.

#### A Superior Product

When compared to rebar, Helix® Micro Rebar® can increase fatigue resistance by up to 300%, and
flexural strength by up to 33%.

[Explore Benefits][61]
* ##### People-first approach:
  
  Our firm commitment to customer support includes guidance from the initial design phase through
  on-site installation.
* ##### Commitment to sustainability:
  
  Our advanced technologies reduce the amount of cement needed, resulting in a smaller carbon
  footprint. We have implemented renewable energy to achieve our goal of carbon neutrality by 2050.
* ##### Proven expertise and reliability:
  
  We have a long list of successful projects, such as the MTA subway tunnel in Manhattan and the
  platform for Seattle’s Ferris Wheel.

#### Why Choose Helix?

As your partner in advanced construction, Helix has more to offer than the other steel rebar
manufacturers:

#### [Concrete Slabs][62]

[Learn More][63]

#### [Footings & Foundations][64]

[Learn More][65]

#### [Concrete Walls][66]

Horse Construction is a professional manufacturer of structural strengthening materials in China.
Our mission is "producing the highest quality structural strengthening materials, removing hidden
perils of concrete structures to save lives and buildings" .

[See Our Company][24]

Horse Construction has six structural strengthening systems cover all of the structural
strengthening industry. Its main products are carbon fiber materials and all kinds of epoxy resin

Horse construction accept structural strengthening products agency to achieve localization services.

structural strengthening products and services have covered over 60 countries and regions.

[See Our Agents][26]

First of all, Horse is a manufacturer of structural strengthening materials, which is cost-effective
and cost-effective compared with similar products. Secondly, the quality of the products is good.
All structural strengthening products have gone through 30 processes, 4 layers of self-inspection
and 3 layers of re-inspection. Third, productivity meets the needs of large and urgent projects.

[See Our Clients ][27]

# Excellent Service Take Full Care Your Request

Service is the promise of the enterprise, the soul of the brand. As the leader of the structural
reinforcement materials industry in China, Horse Construction’s lean sevice would accompany with you
throughout the whole sales term to offer the full set of solutions with innovative consultations and
butler-like service.

[See Our Services][28]

# Thousands of Successful Applications

Horse structural strengthening materials have been used in more than 70,000 projects and sold to 60
countries. It is suitable for the strengthening and repair of various structural types and
structural parts, such as beams, slabs, columns, roof trusses, piers, bridges, cylinders, shells and
other structures.

[See Our Projects ][29]

strengthening industry. Its main products are carbon fiber materials and all kinds of epoxy resin
adhesive, including more than 30 structural strengthening materials.

So far, set up agents in Asia, North America, South America, Europe and other regions. Our
structural strengthening products and services have covered over 60 countries and regions.

[See Our Agents][26]

First of all, Horse is a manufacturer of structural strengthening materials, which is cost-effective
and cost-effective compared with similar products. Secondly, the quality of the products is good.
All structural strengthening products have gone through 30 processes, 4 layers of self-inspection
and 3 layers of re-inspection. Third, productivity meets the needs of large and urgent projects.

[See Our Clients ][27]

# Excellent Service Take Full Care Your Request

Service is the promise of the enterprise, the soul of the brand. As the leader of the structural
reinforcement materials industry in China, Horse Construction’s lean sevice would accompany with you
throughout the whole sales term to offer the full set of solutions with innovative consultations and
butler-like service.

[See Our Services][28]

Horse structural strengthening materials have been used in more than 70,000 projects and sold to 60
countries. It is suitable for the strengthening and repair of various structural types and
structural parts, such as beams, slabs, columns, roof trusses, piers, bridges, cylinders, shells and

##### [2-6 Inch RTP Pipe for Oil & Gas High Pressure Production ][71]

Reinforced Thermoplastic Pipe (RTP) has emerged as a transformative technology in the oil and gas
industry, offering a corrosion-resistant, lightweight alternative to traditional steel pipelines for
high-pressure production. This article provides a comprehensive technical overview of 2-6 inch RTP
pipe production, covering construction, performance specifications, industry standards (API 15S,
DNV-ST-F119), and the advanced manufacturing capabilities of JMG Machinery's complete RTP production
lines. Learn how 2-6 inch RTP pipes deliver working pressures up to 32 MPa, service life of 20+
years, and installation cost savings of up to one-third compared to conventional piping materials.

##### [JMGPE Series High-Speed HDPE/PP/PVC/PE Pipe Extrusion Line ][73]

The JMGPE Series High-Speed Pipe Extrusion Line by JMG Machinery is a single-screw extrusion system
engineered for continuous, high-output production of plastic pipes ranging from OD20mm to OD630mm.
Available in five models (JMGPE63, JMGPE160, JMGPE250, JMGPE500, JMGPE630), the line delivers
capacities from 400kg/h to 1200kg/h, processing HDPE, PP, PVC, and PE materials[reference:1]. Key
features include a high-torque energy-efficient extruder with optimized screw geometry saving up to
15% energy, automatic vacuum calibration and cooling tank, servo-driven haul-off, precision cutting
unit, and an intuitive PLC control system with one-touch start[reference:2][reference:3]. The line
is purpose-built for water supply networks, gas transmission pipelines, geothermal loops, oil field
pipelines, and reinforced composite pipes incorporating fiber, aramid, polyester, or steel tape
reinforcement[reference:4]. Backed by over 15 years of manufacturing experience, in-house R&D, ISO
9001:2015 certi

[READ MORE][74]
14/2026-07
[jmg-machinery-factory-overview.png]

##### [Glass Fiber Tape Winding Reinforced RTP Pipe Production Line ][75]

JMG Machinery’s glass fiber tape winding RTP pipe production line is a turnkey manufacturing system
designed for high-performance reinforced thermoplastic pipes used in oil & gas, water supply, and
geothermal applications. The line integrates inner pipe extrusion, precision multi-station glass
fiber tape winding, outer layer cladding, and automatic cutting/coiling – enabling continuous
on-line production of three-layer composite pipes. Featuring PLC automation, precision tension
control, and synchronized winding angle tracking, it delivers up to 32MPa working pressure and
supports pipe diameters from DN50 to DN300mm. With energy-efficient extruders, quick-change tooling,
and compatibility with aramid/steel cord tapes, this production line offers flexible, cost-effective
solutions. JMG provides full installation, commissioning, and after-sales support. ISO & CE
certified.

In material science and mechanical engineering, the terms toughness and ductility are often used

the same thing. However, toughness and ductility are not identical. They describe different aspects
of how a material behaves under force. Understanding Toughness vs Ductility is very important …

## [What is Ductility?][18]

February 15, 2026 by [Dharmeshkumar][19]

In materials science and mechanical engineering, it’s crucial to understand how materials behave
under stress. Every structure, machine part, or mechanical component in engineering experiences

## Carbon fiber supply chain coverage without catalog clutter.

Product families are organized for engineers and sourcing teams: reinforcements, upstream tow,
prepregs, additives, CFRP profiles and structural strengthening systems.

[[Multiaxial NCF & Carbon Reinforcements]01][126]

### Multiaxial NCF & Carbon Reinforcements

Multiaxial NCF, woven, spread tow and UD reinforcements for infusion, RTM and composite laminates.
* 300gsm Biaxial Carbon NCF
* 600gsm +45°/-45° Biaxial Carbon NCF
* UD / Biaxial / Triaxial / Quadriaxial NCF
* Woven Carbon Fiber Fabric
* 1K Woven Carbon Fiber Fabric
* 3K Twill Carbon Fiber Fabric

[View series ][127]
[[Carbon Fiber Yarn, Tow & Precursor Materials]02][128]

### Carbon Fiber Yarn, Tow & Precursor Materials

Upstream PAN-based yarn, tow and precursor materials for weaving, prepregging, pultrusion and
winding.
* Carbon Fiber Yarn & Tow
* 1K Carbon Fiber Yarn
* 3K Carbon Fiber Yarn
* 6K Carbon Fiber Yarn
* 12K Carbon Fiber Tow
* 24K / 48K / 50K Carbon Fiber Tow

[View series ][129]
[[Prepreg Carbon Fiber Materials]03][130]

### Prepreg Carbon Fiber Materials

Independent prepreg material series with controlled resin content for repeatable laminate
production.
* Prepreg Carbon Fiber Fabric
* Woven Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* 3K Twill Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* UD Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* Spread Tow Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* Custom Carbon Fiber Prepreg

[View series ][131]
[[Chopped & Milled Carbon Fiber]04][132]

### Chopped & Milled Carbon Fiber

Short fiber, milled fiber and carbon fiber powder for plastic, resin, friction and conductive
applications.
* Chopped Carbon Fiber
* Milled Carbon Fiber
* Carbon Fiber Powder
* Carbon Fiber for Plastic & Resin Reinforcement

[View series ][133]
[[3K Carbon Fiber Plates & Custom Parts]05][134]

### 3K Carbon Fiber Plates & Custom Parts

3K twill laminate sheets, CNC plates, tubes and custom CFRP components based on drawings or samples.
* 3K Twill Carbon Fiber Laminate Sheet
* Matte / Glossy Carbon Fiber Plate
* CNC Cut Carbon Fiber Plate
* Carbon Fiber Tube
* Roll-Wrapped Carbon Fiber Tube
* Filament-Wound Carbon Fiber Tube

[View series ][135]
[[Structural Strengthening System]06][136]

### Structural Strengthening System

A separate CFRP strengthening portfolio for civil reinforcement, distinct from ordinary UD fabric
supply.
* UD Carbon Fiber Fabric for Structural Strengthening
* Pultruded Carbon Fiber Plate / CFRP Laminate
* Structural Epoxy Resin
* CFRP Strengthening System

prepregs, additives, CFRP profiles and structural strengthening systems.

Multiaxial NCF, woven, spread tow and UD reinforcements for infusion, RTM and composite laminates.
* 300gsm Biaxial Carbon NCF
* 600gsm +45°/-45° Biaxial Carbon NCF
* UD / Biaxial / Triaxial / Quadriaxial NCF
* Woven Carbon Fiber Fabric
* 1K Woven Carbon Fiber Fabric
* 3K Twill Carbon Fiber Fabric

[View series ][127]
[[Carbon Fiber Yarn, Tow & Precursor Materials]02][128]

Upstream PAN-based yarn, tow and precursor materials for weaving, prepregging, pultrusion and
winding.
* Carbon Fiber Yarn & Tow

* 3K Carbon Fiber Yarn
* 6K Carbon Fiber Yarn
* 12K Carbon Fiber Tow
* 24K / 48K / 50K Carbon Fiber Tow

[View series ][129]

production.

* UD Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* Spread Tow Carbon Fiber Prepreg
* Custom Carbon Fiber Prepreg

[View series ][131]

* Filament-Wound Carbon Fiber Tube

COMPARE / SPEC-A vs SPEC-B

## Volumetric vs Traditional Ready Mix

See why Calgary contractors and homeowners are switching to on-site mixing.

SPEC-A

### Traditional Ready Mix

The Old Way
* ✕ Must be poured within 60–90 minutes of batching
* ✕ Pay for the entire load regardless of amount used
* ✕ Cannot adjust mix design or slump after leaving plant
* ✕ Traffic delays can compromise your entire load
* ✕ Waste material requires costly disposal
* ✕ Limited flexibility for project changes on-the-fly
SPEC-B · RECOMMENDED

### Omega Volumetric

The Smarter Choice
* ✓ Fresh concrete mixed on-site — no time pressure
* ✓ Pay only for what you actually use
* ✓ Adjust mix design and slump on the spot
* ✓ No risk from traffic or delivery delays
* ✓ Zero waste — nothing to dispose of
* ✓ Complete flexibility for any project change
FLEET / SPEC SHEET 001

## Volumetric Mixers
## Built for Alberta

Each truck carries cement, aggregates, water, and admixtures separately, then mixes the exact
concrete you need on-site. Real-time slump control, digital batch records, and precise volume
measurement come standard.

## Questions About Volumetric

Everything Calgary contractors and homeowners ask us before their first pour with Omega.

/ 01 What is volumetric concrete? +
Volumetric concrete is fresh concrete mixed on-site inside a mobile mixing truck, right at your
project location. Unlike traditional ready mix — which is batched at a plant and delivered pre-mixed
— volumetric trucks carry raw materials separately and mix them on demand. You get concrete that is
always fresh, adjustable in real time, and billed only for the volume you actually use.
/ 02 How is Omega different from traditional concrete suppliers? +
Traditional ready mix must be poured within 60 to 90 minutes of batching, and you pay for the full
load whether you use it or not. Omega Ready Mix mixes concrete on-site, so there is no time
pressure, no waste, and the mix design can be adjusted at the pour. That flexibility is why Calgary
contractors and homeowners increasingly specify volumetric.
/ 03 Do you deliver to residential projects? +
Yes. Omega Ready Mix serves both commercial contractors and homeowners across Calgary and
surrounding areas. We handle driveways, patios, sidewalks, garage floors, and foundation pours with
no minimum order quantity — a major advantage over traditional suppliers who often refuse small
residential pours.
/ 04 What areas does Omega serve? +
We deliver across the Calgary metropolitan area including Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, Okotoks,
Strathmore, and surrounding communities in Southern Alberta. Dispatchers are available 24/7 to
schedule deliveries city-wide.
/ 05 Can I get concrete delivered on weekends or after hours? +
Yes. Omega Ready Mix operates a 24/7 dispatch line. Weekend, evening, and early-morning deliveries
are available by appointment across Calgary — ideal for shift-schedule constraints or time-sensitive
commercial pours.
/ 06 Do you pour in Calgary winters? +
Yes. Our volumetric trucks are heated and equipped for Alberta winter conditions. Cold-weather
admixtures and heated water are standard on winter pours. We recommend booking additional lead time
for temperatures below -15°C so we can spec the correct mix and cure protection.
/ 07 How do I get a quote? +
Call our dispatch at (403) 217-4888 or use the "Get Free Quote" button anywhere on this site.
Provide the volume, mix requirements, jobsite address, and preferred delivery window. Most quotes
are returned within one business hour.

## Questions About Volumetric

Everything Calgary contractors and homeowners ask us before their first pour with Omega.

/ 01 What is volumetric concrete? +
Volumetric concrete is fresh concrete mixed on-site inside a mobile mixing truck, right at your
project location. Unlike traditional ready mix — which is batched at a plant and delivered pre-mixed
— volumetric trucks carry raw materials separately and mix them on demand. You get concrete that is
always fresh, adjustable in real time, and billed only for the volume you actually use.
/ 02 How is Omega different from traditional concrete suppliers? +
Traditional ready mix must be poured within 60 to 90 minutes of batching, and you pay for the full
load whether you use it or not. Omega Ready Mix mixes concrete on-site, so there is no time
pressure, no waste, and the mix design can be adjusted at the pour. That flexibility is why Calgary
contractors and homeowners increasingly specify volumetric.
/ 03 Do you deliver to residential projects? +
Yes. Omega Ready Mix serves both commercial contractors and homeowners across Calgary and
surrounding areas. We handle driveways, patios, sidewalks, garage floors, and foundation pours with
no minimum order quantity — a major advantage over traditional suppliers who often refuse small
residential pours.
/ 04 What areas does Omega serve? +
We deliver across the Calgary metropolitan area including Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, Okotoks,
Strathmore, and surrounding communities in Southern Alberta. Dispatchers are available 24/7 to
schedule deliveries city-wide.
/ 05 Can I get concrete delivered on weekends or after hours? +
Yes. Omega Ready Mix operates a 24/7 dispatch line. Weekend, evening, and early-morning deliveries
are available by appointment across Calgary — ideal for shift-schedule constraints or time-sensitive
commercial pours.
/ 06 Do you pour in Calgary winters? +
Yes. Our volumetric trucks are heated and equipped for Alberta winter conditions. Cold-weather
admixtures and heated water are standard on winter pours. We recommend booking additional lead time
for temperatures below -15°C so we can spec the correct mix and cure protection.
/ 07 How do I get a quote? +
Call our dispatch at (403) 217-4888 or use the "Get Free Quote" button anywhere on this site.
Provide the volume, mix requirements, jobsite address, and preferred delivery window. Most quotes
are returned within one business hour.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

# Advanced Concrete Fiber Reinforcement Solutions for Crack Control

24 Years of Engineering Focus on Crack Control and Durability

For 24 years, PIONEER® has focused on one fundamental challenge—concrete cracking, the key to
concrete durability and long-term structural performance.

Instead of relying on welded wire mesh, steel fiber, polypropylene fibers, or membrane
waterproofing, PIONEER® controls cracks at their source—within the concrete itself, through an
integrated durability system:

##### 1.  Rimix™ 3D — Macro Reinforcement for Slabs and Floors

A high-performance macro synthetic fiber for fiber reinforced concrete, forming a three-dimensional
reinforcement network to improve toughness and deliver consistent crack control in slabs and floor
systems

##### 2.  Rimix™ NanoRebar — Micro Reinforcement for Crack Control

An advanced micro synthetic fiber reinforcement system designed to reduce fiber spacing and create a
dense internal structure, effectively controlling crack initiation and propagation.

##### 3.  CrystalGuard™ — Self-Healing Technology for Waterproof Concrete

A crystalline waterproofing system that reacts within the concrete to seal pores and repair
microcracks, enabling self-healing concrete and long-term waterproof performance.

## Rimix™ NanoRebar High-Performance Fiber

Next-Generation Micro Synthetic Fiber for High-Performance Concrete

Rimix™ NanoRebar enhances concrete crack control and durability through high fiber count and dense
distributed reinforcement, offering a significant upgrade over conventional polypropylene fibers.
* ### More Effective Crack Control

With a much higher fiber count at lower dosage, NanoRebar increases the probability of intercepting
micro-cracks early, reducing visible cracking in slabs and structural elements.
* ### Full-Stage Crack Control

Higher tensile strength and modulus enable NanoRebar to perform in both plastic and hardened stages,
controlling early shrinkage and long-term cracking.
* ### Improved Toughness and Reliability

Dense micro reinforcement improves crack bridging, enhances toughness, and reduces brittle behavior
under load and long-term service conditions.
* ### High Efficiency Without Added Cost

Lower dosage combined with higher effectiveness delivers improved performance at a comparable cost
per cubic meter.

Rimix™ NanoRebar enhances concrete crack control and durability through high fiber count and dense
distributed reinforcement, offering a significant upgrade over conventional polypropylene fibers.

micro-cracks early, reducing visible cracking in slabs and structural elements.

controlling early shrinkage and long-term cracking.

Dense micro reinforcement improves crack bridging, enhances toughness, and reduces brittle behavior
under load and long-term service conditions.
* ### High Efficiency Without Added Cost

Lower dosage combined with higher effectiveness delivers improved performance at a comparable cost
per cubic meter.

Steel fibers are an important reinforcement material in many industrial and civil engineering
applications. They can be used as primary or secondary reinforcement in concrete, asphalt, and other
composite materials. Steel fibers can improve the performance of these materials in a number of
ways, including:



-increasing the flexural strength

-increasing the tensile strength

-increasing the impact resistance

-increasing the abrasion resistance

###### HOW WE WORK

## Producing eco-friendly steel with minimal future impact.
* Advanced metals for a healthier planet
* Championing 'Advanced metals for a healthier planet' signifies a dedication to pioneering
  metallurgical innovations that prioritize environmental sustainability in the production of
  eco-friendly steel. This commitment involves adopting cutting-edge materials and alloys to enhance
  steel properties while concurrently embracing eco-friendly manufacturing processes. The focus
  extends to reducing carbon footprint through low-carbon production methods, circular economy
  practices, and carbon capture technologies. Additionally, the approach includes resource-efficient
  strategies, such as optimizing raw material usage and promoting steel recycling, contributing to a
  closed-loop system. Investing in ongoing research and development underscores a commitment to
  continuous improvement and staying abreast of evolving sustainable practices in the steel
  industry, ensuring a harmonious evolution with environmental stewardship for a resilient and
  healthier planet.
* Innovative alloys for a greener world
* The concept of 'Innovative alloys for a greener world' encapsulates a commitment to advancing
  metallurgy with cutting-edge alloy formulations that prioritize sustainability. This initiative
  involves the development and implementation of alloys designed to enhance the performance and
  durability of steel while minimizing environmental impact. By leveraging innovative alloys, the
  aim is to create a greener world by reducing energy consumption, lowering greenhouse gas
  emissions, and optimizing the use of resources in the steel production process. These
  forward-looking alloys contribute to a more sustainable and eco-friendly steel industry, aligning
  with the broader goal of mitigating environmental challenges and fostering a greener, more
  resilient planet.
* Sustainable solutions for modern industry
* In the realm of producing eco-friendly steel with minimal future impact, the emphasis on
  'Sustainable solutions for modern industry' underscores a commitment to adopting environmentally
  conscious practices throughout the steel production process. This approach involves implementing
  innovative and sustainable solutions that address the challenges of modern industrial practices.
  From utilizing energy-efficient technologies to optimizing raw material usage, the focus is on
  creating a more sustainable and eco-friendly steel industry. By integrating sustainable solutions,
  the aim is to minimize the environmental footprint, reduce carbon emissions, and contribute to a
  greener and more sustainable future for the steel manufacturing sector. This commitment aligns
  with the broader goal of harmonizing industrial activities with environmental stewardship for the
  benefit of present and future generations.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

## Welcome to Tianxing

TianXing Technical Textiles, established in 1997, is a reputable company specializing in the
production of high-quality Flex banners, Knife coated Tarpaulins, Semi-coated Tarpaulins, PVC Mesh,
PVC Sheets, PVC Geogrids, and more. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, we provide
top-notch sales and consultation services to ensure the ideal solutions for your specific needs.

[Read More...][13]

## Why Choose Us

[[Road Textiles, PVC Mesh, Colorful Mesh - TianXing]][14]

Why Choose Us

When it comes to technical textiles, there are many companies to choose from. However, TianXing
Technical Textiles sets itself apart from the competition. Established in 1997, we have been in the
industry for over two decades and have gained a reputation for our high-quality products and
exceptional customer service. In this article, we will delve into the reasons why you should choose
us for all your technical textile needs.

First and foremost, the range of products we offer is extensive and varied. Whether you require Flex
banners, Knife coated Tarpaulins, Semi-coated Tarpaulins, PVC Mesh, PVC Sheets, PVC Geogrids, or any
other technical textile, we have got you covered. Our products are designed to cater to different
industries and applications, ensuring that you find the perfect solution for your specific needs. We
utilize advanced manufacturing techniques and the finest materials to craft our products, ensuring
durability, longevity, and performance.

Quality is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards in
our products, from their design to their production. Our team of skilled professionals constantly
strives for excellence and pays meticulous attention to detail throughout the manufacturing process.
We conduct extensive quality control checks to ensure that every product leaving our facility meets
the stringent criteria we have set. By choosing us, you can rest assured that you will receive
top-notch, reliable products that will exceed your expectations.

As a customer-focused company, we prioritize your satisfaction above all else. We understand that
each client has unique requirements and preferences. Therefore, we offer customization options for
many of our products. Whether you need a specific size, color, or design, we can tailor our products
to meet your specifications. Our team will work closely with you to understand your needs and
deliver a personalized solution that perfectly fits your requirements. We believe in building
long-term relationships with our clients, and their happiness is our ultimate goal.

In addition to the quality of our products, we take pride in our exceptional customer service. Our
dedicated and knowledgeable team is always ready to assist you and provide guidance throughout your
buying process. From inquiries to order placement and even after-sales support, we are here to help.
We believe in clear and open communication, and we strive to promptly address any questions or
concerns you may have. Your satisfaction and peace of mind matter to us, and we go the extra mile to
ensure you have a positive experience when dealing with us.
